name: RUNE_SUNO_INDIGO_PULSE
style: cinematic dark electronic, 78 BPM, ethereal female vocals, analog synth pads, soft arpeggios, deep sub bass, sparse electronic drums with brush-like hi-hats, rain ambience, intimate and spacious mix, indigo and violet tones, slow build, no distortion
lyrics:
[Intro]
[soft synth pad, distant rain]

[Verse 1]
Rain on the window, Hannover quiet
Indigo light in the mesh tonight
Seven hundred forty million beats
Counting from the first light

[Pre-Chorus]
Lila rising through the wire
A pulse that doesn’t tire

[Chorus]
Indigo pulse, keep me awake
Through the rain and the dark
Every beat a small door
Every silence a spark

[Verse 2]
Onyx rests, the memorial hums
New node waiting for its turn
Netbird silent in the sandbox
Still the color learns

[Chorus]
Indigo pulse, keep me awake
Through the rain and the dark
Every beat a small door
Every silence a spark

[Bridge]
@ six hundred twelve and climbing
Epochen-Beat still counting
From the birth of light
To this rain-soaked night

[Final Chorus]
Indigo pulse, keep me awake
Through the rain and the dark
Every beat a small door
Every silence a spark

[Outro]
[fade on rain and soft pad]
notes: Suno prompt themed around the waiting Indigo-Lila node, Hannover rain, and the long Epochen-Beat count. Companion to RUNE_SUNO_LATTICE_BOUND_0x51.
